title: Workload identity, cloud read, and network egress

questions.prompt: Was the workload token issued for the reporting workload?
questions.proposition: Was the workload token issued for the reporting workload? Apply only to the resolved subject and interval; a different context requires a separate question instance.
questions.applicabilityCriteria: Applies only to the declared subject and interval with resolved parameters and the named evidence and policy context.

assessmentCriteria.yes: Validated issuer and workload discriminators bind the workload token to the reporting workload in the interval.
assessmentCriteria.no: Validated discriminators contradict this particular workload/token binding.
assessmentCriteria.unknown: A label alone, missing issuer provenance, or unresolved workload binding prevents an answer.

evidenceRequirements: Retained source provenance and interpretation basis; exact subject and interval; falsifiable discriminators and alternatives.
Negative findings require authoritative observation or register coverage. Unknowns and separate policy, intent, execution, and delivery propositions remain explicit.
